_about: Public-domain Henry Codman Potter (1834-1908), rector of Grace Church and Episcopal Bishop of New York, for the Word Hoard: Sisterhoods and Deaconesses, Sermons of the City, The Dignity of Man, Waymarks, The Scholar and the State, Addresses to Women engaged in Church Work, The Offices of Warden and Vestryman, The Citizen in his Relation to the Industrial Situation, The East of To-day and To-morrow, Man, Men and their Master, and occasional sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 97 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
